name: Shaban Ahmad
bio:
Shaban is a postdoctoral researcher (PhD in AI in Biology; MSc in Bioinformatics) working on AI-driven discovery of PFAS-degrading enzymes. His research focuses on developing automated, fully reproducible defluorination pipelines, including DefluorX, HADefluorX, and other computational frameworks, to identify and prioritise variants of FAcDs, HADs, and related enzyme families. These pipelines integrate AI-driven modelling with physics-aware validation, incorporating WaterMap, molecular dynamics simulations, and QM/MM calculations to support the lab's FAcD and HAD enzyme screening efforts.

Shaban brings extensive expertise in artificial intelligence, with a strong background in explainable AI for the biological sciences, including drug design, genomics, and other omics applications. He also has experience in grant writing and is currently developing the leadership skills required for a future independent group leader.
